title: ebnerella carretii
intro: Ebnerella carretii, commonly known as the Carrot Tansy or Tansy of the Carrots, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which may aid in wound healing and digestion. The therapeutic actions of Ebnerella carretii include its ability to act as a carminative, helping to alleviate flatulence and indigestion, as well as its use in traditional medicine as a treatment for fever and rheumatic pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety.
